description: This file defines a Flutter widget named 'SeconderyProductSkelton', which is a stateless widget used to display a skeleton UI placeholder for a secondary product item in an e-commerce app. It includes layout and placeholder elements to mimic a product card layout.

classes.name: SeconderyProductSkelton
classes.description: A Flutter widget providing a skeleton placeholder for a secondary product display, capable of adjusting its layout based on the 'isSmall' flag.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the skeleton placeholder, arranging layout elements such as images and text placeholders.
